comments: Chosen assumptions: agent1 accelerates straight the wrong way from 50–65 m ahead in ego’s lane. Ego travels in the intended direction, then changes into an available same-direction right lane when separation drops below 32–38 m and no object is within 5–7 m in that lane. Agent1 initiates; ego responds by lateral avoidance without an intersection turn. Conflict opportunity, without a required collision.
